norwill simmonds.bio: Norwill Simmonds is a Jamaican-born, Canada-based gospel singer, songwriter and broadcaster who has spent decades making music in Ontario. After beginning to record as a child in Jamaica, he settled in Canada, recorded three gospel albums here and became host of Morning Dew Gospel Music on iLive Toronto. He is also the father of Daniel Caesar; his vocal and songwriting feature on Caesar's Baby Blue is the Northern Dial library credit.

solar-c.bio: Solar-C is a Canadian hip-hop lyricist associated with the Toronto-area Gillbreathing family alongside Elaquent, Es and Mathematik. His catalogue includes the 2018 album Access To All Lanes, the CrossLakes collaboration Sunshowers and later work with Reazhun, Mathematik and Lanai. His appearance with Mathematik and Es on Elaquent's Carnival is the Northern Dial library credit.

sunclef.bio: Sunclef is Toronto producer and DJ Matt Hedlin, an early-2010s fixture in the city's beat scene whose instrumental music blends hip-hop, funk, jazz, electronic music and future soul. His releases include The Tesseract and Attoseconds, alongside production for Buck 65 and collaborations with a l l i e; his feature with a l l i e on 2nd Son's Cluster Flux is the Northern Dial library credit.

sunayna sharma.bio: Sunayna Sharma is a Toronto-based singer and songwriter whose soulful vocals move between South Asian pop, R&B and hip-hop. She entered the wider Canadian music conversation through her collaboration with AR Paisley and producers Jay Trak and PVLN on the 2025 single One Way Flight, which is also her Northern Dial library credit.

wizdome bunitall.bio: Wizdome Bunitall, also known as DJ Bunitall, is Canadian DJ, producer and music-industry veteran Joshua Barclay. Active since the early 2000s, he has worked across promotion, A&R, DJing and production while remaining tied to Toronto's underground hip-hop scene. His full-length collaborations with Asun Eastwood include Let Me Talk My Sh*t and Let Me Talk My Sh*t Too; his production and artist credit on Toro 4's featuring JD Era is the Northern Dial library entry.
